segments.thag8.1:1.1: “Kammaṃ bahukaṃ na kāraye, parivajjeyya janaṃ na uyyame;
segments.thag8.1:1.3: So ussukko rasānugiddho, atthaṃ riñcati yo sukhādhivāho.
segments.thag8.1:2.1: “Paṅkoti hi naṃ avedayuṃ, yāyaṃ vandanapūjanā kulesu;
segments.thag8.1:2.3: Sukhumaṃ sallaṃ durubbahaṃ, sakkāro kāpurisena dujjaho.
segments.thag8.1:3.3: Attanā taṃ na seveyya, kammabandhūhi mātiyā.
segments.thag8.1:4.1: “Na pare vacanā coro, na pare vacanā muni;
segments.thag8.1:4.3: Attā ca naṃ yathāvedi [yathā vetti (sī.)], devāpi naṃ tathā vidū.
segments.thag8.1:5.3: Ye ca tattha vijānanti, tato sammanti medhagā.
segments.thag8.1:6.3: Paññāya ca alābhena [abhāvena (sī. aṭṭha.)], vittavāpi na jīvati.
segments.thag8.1:7.3: Na ca diṭṭhaṃ sutaṃ dhīro, sabbaṃ ujjhitumarahati.
